comment: Lol Golander is annoyed with a band called Mouthful of Mutton.\n\tYou think they make the same kind of music as Morning Glory, but Lol Golander says Mouthful is disgracing a great genre.\n\tGiven the chance Lol Golander says in an interview that Mouthful of Mutton play "music for old blind ladies with hearing aids."
Mouthful of Mutton's front man Billy Mutton is furious.\n\tHe says he'll make an album about <¤CBand.name> to show the world what wimps they are.

Billy Mutton says to Radio FM that he accepts the apology you made and that he regrets the foul words.\n\tAt the same time, he reminds listeners of his earlier career as a pro-wrestler and warns the public about crossing Mouthful of Mutton.

You tell City News that Billy Mutton's past as a pro-wrestler is "mumbo-jumbo," and that it's a stand-in posing half-naked with an executioner's mask on MoM's record cover, not Mutton himself.\n\tCity News takes the bait, giving the story a full page spread.

City News runs a full page article on the "Rock Battle"  the quarrel between <¤CBand.name> and Mouthful of Mutton.\n\tIt says that several <¤CBand.name> fans have been assaulted by MoM fans and that retailers consider banning your records.
TV24 invite <¤CBand.name> and Mouthful of Mutton to a live broadcasted duel.\n\tThey want you to appear on a popular debate show called Today's Opinion and determine which band really rocks.

Billy Mutton gives a statement to City News saying, "If there were Olympic Games for wimps, <¤Cband.name> would win the gold with one arm tied behind their backs."\n\tHe says that since you don't dare settle things with Mouthful of Mutton on TV, you have forever lost your respect with the rock fans.

There is little doubt that <¤CBand.name> owns this city, after they won the Rock 'n' Roll duel on TV24's Today's Opinion.
	You creamed Mouthful of Mutton and the studio audience loved it.
	Now Mutton will keep his big mouth shut.
	Ironically, the Golander brothers seemed to enjoy each others company for a moment.

Mouthful of Mutton humiliate you on TV24's broadcasted rock duel. <¤CBand.name> make horrible mistakes and look really scared.\n\tMouthful of Mutton frightened the living daylights out of the host with their distorted bass riffs, sending the audience into hysterics.
After hours of 'creative argument' in the practice room, Lol hits Nelly over the head with a shoe, and walks out.\n\tNelly is ok, but he wants you to fire his brother from the band.

When Nelly tapes Lol's mouth shut with duct tape, Lol loses his temper and tries to strangle his brother with a guitar string.\n\tFortunately, you manage to tear them apart before anybody is badly injured.

Lol is playing with a lighter during practice and "accidentally" sets fire to his brother's brand new designer jeans.\n\tThe flame is quickly put out, but the jeans are ruined and you have to hold Nelly back to keep him from beating Lol's face (which would be fatal for the press photos).
Your attempt to change the band name absolutely infuriates the brothers.\n\tThey say if they can't be Morning Glory, they won't be anything at all.\n\tYou have no choice but to change it back.

The artists easily fight each other or get in a bad mood.
	One of your most important tasks is to make sure they're happy. Otherwise, they might quit the band or worse.
	Click a musician to find a list of actions. Try giving them different things, but remember they have a mind of their own. Don't just give them anything to make them happy.
	Don't worry, they will certainly let you know if they are unhappy.

Global Records honcho G. Jerome Vonderbaldt calls you to a private meeting. He says that so far he has not read one word about the Golander brothers in the press, nor heard their songs on the radio. They should be on all shows, all of the time!\n\tVonderbaldt hopes you have a media plan, because failure is not an option according to Global corporate policy.

You are called up to Global Records to receive a lecture from the company's furious president.\n\tYour primary goal is to keep the Golander brothers together, but the point of all business is to make money. So far you've sold less than Global's worst-selling artist ever: Eric Flanders.\n\tThat's a record you don't want to break.

Nelly Golander is furious that you would have Morning Glory play any other song than his masterpiece, "Supermarket Love."\n\tHe has spent years writing that song, a  true statement describing Morning Glory's stance.\n\tHe wants you to reconsider.

<¤CRealMusician.name> is mad because you're giving his brother more gifts than you're giving him.\n\tHe thinks it's important for a manager to be fair to the artists and give them gifts in equal measures.
<¤CRealMusician.name> is mad because you are training his brother more than you are training him.\n\tHe asks if you think it's important to train all band members.

<¤CRealMusician.name> is disappointed with the record cover.\n\t<¤CRealMusician.Firstname> feels that {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]}'s not prominent enough on the cover, and wonders if you think {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]}'s less important than the others in the band.\n\tIf so, why not just fire {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>, #Object:1]}?
Nelly Golander is concerned about the fighting. He didn't start making music just too pick fights with other bands.\n\tIf the fighting doesn't end soon Nelly Golander will leave the band.

How hard could it be?\n\tYou were supposed to keep two brothers from fighting for a few months, yet you still failed! No wonder no one thinks you're a competent manager.\n\tYou can forget about the offer from Global, too.

How hard could it be?\n\tYou were supposed to keep two brothers from fighting for a few months, yet you still failed! No wonder no one thinks you're a competent manager.\n\tYou can forget about the offer from Global, too.
Try again and make sure to get it right next time.\n\tGive them plenty of gifts to keep them happy, just make sure to give them equal amounts.\n\tAlso try gigs and holidays to keep their chins up.
You're out of cash? That's a joke, considering how much money Global threw at you!
Next time, watch your expense account. Do a few gigs to earn some money.
You really think Global would let you sign their golden nugget to another label? You're fired and Global won't have anything to do with you.
The Global Aid-gala will be held thirty days from today.
The Global Aid-gala will be held ten days from today.
This mission requires that you stay with Global Records. Start over and next time do not cancel the record contract!
